{{Quote|Anywhere, come on, sit down! Right, shoes off! Boots, sandals, everything on the floor! Toss it in! Come on, move it, bare feet, let's go!|The guard, to prisoners on a prison transport|<ref name="Narkina" />}}
A [[human]] served as a '''transpo guard''' on an [[Imperial Prison Transport]] for the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Narkina" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|108}}</ref> he<ref name="Narkina AD" /> assisted in the transportation of five [[prisoner]]s, including the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], from the [[planet]] [[Niamos]] to the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]].<ref name="Narkina" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The transpo guard first appeared in the [[Andor Season 1|''Andor'' Season 1]] episode "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]],"<ref name="Narkina" /> which released on [[October 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> He was portrayed by [[Jimmy Walker]] and credited as "Transpo Guard #1."<ref name="Narkina" />
